subject: POC kickoff & routing policy working session — reschedule request
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jules Park <jules.park@novaplay.com>, Priya Singh <priya@novaplay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: POC kickoff — proposed times + agenda (prompt review, routing, load tests)

Hi Jules / Priya —

Excited to get the POC started. Per our conversation last week, we'd like to run a focused kickoff that combines a short demo with a hands-on routing policy workshop and an initial load-test plan. Proposed agenda (60–90m):

- 10m introductions & success criteria
- 20m demo: prompt flows + response shape expectations
- 30m working session: routing policy (model selection, tiering, fallback rules, region routing)
- 15m load test plan and next steps

Proposed times (all in CEST — I listed a couple slots to accommodate EMEA preference):
- Wed 22 Jul, 09:00–10:30 CEST
- Thu 23 Jul, 14:00–15:30 CEST
- Fri 24 Jul, 11:00–12:30 CEST

Attachments: POC_agenda_routing_v1.pdf (agenda + prep), redwood_preflight_checklist.xlsx (simple checklist for test data & VPN access).

Can you confirm which slot works for the technical folks (and whether Matt from your infra team will join for the load-test piece)? Also let us know if you want us to pre-load any sample prompts or datasets into the environment.

If none of these work, send two times that do and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to getting hands-on.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0124

[Attachment: POC_agenda_routing_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: redwood_preflight_checklist.xlsx]

Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:18:00 +0200
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed times + agenda (prompt review, routing, load tests)

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the clear agenda. Heads up — our product lead is in a EMEA offsite on the 22nd and 23rd and won't be available in the morning. We can do Fri 24 Jul but need to shift it slightly later to accommodate a site visit (can you do 12:00–13:30 CEST instead of the 11:00 slot?).

Also a couple notes so we’re set:
- We want the working session to focus on region-aware routing (EU first, fallback to us-west), and a conservative fallback model to minimize cost/latency spikes.
- Our security team will want a quick look at how the KV cache / prompt caching is handled during load tests. Matt will join for that piece.
- We’ll send a short list of sample prompts and expected failure modes ahead of the session.

If 24 Jul 12:00–13:30 CEST works, confirm and we’ll send calendar invites.

Cheers,
Jules
Jules Park
Head of Product, Novaplay
jules.park@novaplay.com

Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — Fri 24 Jul 12:00 CEST confirmed? + prep notes

Thanks Jules — 24 Jul 12:00–13:30 CEST works for us. I’ve provisionally reserved the slot and created a conference link; I’ll send the official calendar invite once you confirm attendees.

Quick prep notes so the session is productive:
- Model selection: please flag any disallowed model families or a target latency threshold (e.g., 95th percentile < 400ms). We’ll bring a recommended tiering map (fast, balanced, cost) and short rationale for model choices.
- Fallback rules: we’ll demo two fallback patterns: region-fallback (EU -> US) and model-tier-fallback (fast -> balanced -> cost). We’ll show warm KV-cache behavior and how caching affects failover latency.
- Load tests: Matt, can you confirm whether you want the tests to run from your EU region agents (preferred) or should we drive load from our US test harness? We can do both but need to align on IP allowlists.
- Prompts: Jules, appreciate you sharing the sample prompts — please drop them via SFTP link or attach to the reply. Redacted examples are fine.

Action items:
- Diego: send calendar invite + meeting link once Jules confirms attendees (advise if any other teams should join).
- Marissa: bring pricing/commit options for Dedicated tiers in case we get into throughput questions.
- Hannah: have a short demo snippet prepared showing continuous batching and KV-cache metrics.

Attachments: redwood_preflight_checklist.xlsx (reminder).

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Conference link: https://meet.redwoodinference.com/j/POC-6789]

Hi all —

Confirming Novaplay will attend Fri 24 Jul 12:00–13:30 CEST. Attendees: Jules, Priya, Matt (infra), Lina Gomez (data product), and Soren (sec reviewer). We will upload a short set of redacted prompts to the SFTP by EOD today and include a note about expected failure modes.

One small ask on the agenda: can we reserve 10–15 minutes at the end to agree on go/no-go criteria for the POC (throughput, stability, and a quick quality check)? That would help our procurement and security teams.

Thanks, and see you Friday.

Priya Singh
